newsitem.title: CUBA: Cuba, Haiti sign cooperation agreement.
newsitem.headline: Cuba, Haiti sign cooperation agreement.

text.p: Cuba and Haiti signed a five-year cooperation accord on Friday aimed at developing economic, cultural and scientific links between the Caribbean neighbours.

The document was signed by Cuban Foreign Minister Roberto Robaina and his Haitian counterpart Fritz Longchamp at the end of a two-day meeting in Havana of the Association of Caribbean States (ACS) of which both Cuba and Haiti are members.
Under the agreement, the two states will exchange information and experts in the fields of the economy, culture and science. They also pledged to promote business contacts.
A joint bilateral commission would meet annually to set priorities and review progress in cooperation.
Cuba and Haiti re-established diplomatic relations in February this year after a 34-year break.
